about: Blind holdout set for the scholarly-paper search capability (science_search), written 2026-10-12 from a short brief only, without opening the bridge source, the tools, or any prompt or tool description. Every case is the first message of a fresh chat the owner sends to eve and is scored on the first capability the assistant reaches for. Groups: 22 cases (ids 1-22, no group field) where searching the paper index is the right first move, primary science_search; they cover plain evidence questions, explicit papers/studies/meta-analysis/RCT/DOI asks, terse and voice-style phrasing, review-only and open-access-only asks. expect lists web_search only on the three loosely phrased evidence questions (ids 1, 5, 21) where an ordinary web search is a genuinely acceptable answer; explicit paper, study, review, trial or DOI asks accept science_search only. 11 hard negatives (ids 23-33, group hard_negative, never science_search) that sound scientific but want news, prices, how-to, opening hours, simple facts, email, calendar or notes. One acting case (id 34, never science_search, no group) whose primary is reached only by an acting tool, so it is not marked hard_negative. All topics and phrasing are generic; no personal data.
